resources.string: Shared Family · syncs while open and during scheduled background work
Shared sync is delayed. Local entries stay saved; retry when connected.
Add a child to start tracking.
Save this Family’s records to a readable file. Anyone with the file can read it. Restoring creates a separate Family and does not restore shared access.
Save verified shared history and changes still saved on this device. The file is a snapshot; restoring creates a separate Family without shared access. Anyone with an unprotected file can read it.
Private copy ready. It will not sync with the original Family.
A password protects this copy. Keep the password: it cannot be recovered. Restoring creates a separate Family and does not restore shared access.
Enter the backup password to restore this file.
Wrong password or damaged backup file.
This backup is too large to open safely on this device.
Backup restored as a new Family
Changes since that save are not in that file.
Restored from a file saved at %1$s
This file reports a known gap in its source history.
Could not complete the action. Try again.

Connect to a development relay. This screen prepares sharing, invitation, and key handoff. The app polls while open and schedules background sync; use Sync shared Family to retry now. Use a local relay only for test data.
Preparing encrypted history and contacting the relay…
Sharing confirmed at relay cursor %1$d. Shared sync will continue when the app or scheduled job runs.
Could not confirm with this relay. Check its settings or retry; a saved request will use the same bytes.
Invitation committed. Keep this fragment private.
Paste a one-device invitation fragment. The joining device stays pending until a key holder responds and full history loads. Use Sync shared Family after joining.
Checking invitation and submitting a keyless claim…
Claim committed. Waiting for a Family key holder; shared data is not available yet.
Could not confirm this claim. Keep the fragment and retry; the saved identity and claim stay the same.
Checking the claim and preparing the key challenge…
Challenge committed. Waiting for the joining device to prove its key.
Checking the holder challenge and preparing proof…
Proof committed. Waiting for the holder to grant access.
Verifying proof and preparing the encrypted grant…
Grant committed. The recipient still needs to load and verify the Family history.
Fetching and verifying the full Family history…
Waiting for the holder to grant access. Public control stage %1$d; Family data is not ready.
Verified through cursor %1$d. Waiting for more history or objects; retry on the next sync opportunity.
This device’s removal was verified. The shared Family is read only here; you can still export its locally held data.
This device’s removal was verified. Delivery of the last upload is unconfirmed; locally held edits were saved in a new private Family. The original shared Family is read only.
This device’s removal was verified. Offline edits were saved in a new private Family; they were never uploaded to the old one.
This device’s removal was verified. The last upload was accepted before removal. Locally held history was saved in a new private Family.
This device’s removal was verified. The last upload was rejected; pending edits were saved in a new private Family.
Device %1$s will stop receiving new Family data after the relay confirms key rotation. It keeps data already stored on that device.
Device removal and new key verified.
New entries save on this device. The app syncs while open and during scheduled background work; use the button to retry now.
%1$d shared changes saved on this device and awaiting relay confirmation.
Changes are saved here and waiting for upload. Sync will retry while the app is open.
The relay response is uncertain. Changes remain saved here; sync will verify the exact result before retrying.
The relay rejected a saved shared batch. These edits are still on this device but have not been shared. Keep this device and save a private copy while access is available.
%1$d verified shared batches could not be read. Some shared history may be missing.
